production_change.behavior: The compile-time Oblivion profile returns no automatic ModelRetry decision. Lost gateway, transient provider failures and rate limits require a new user submission. Normal tool steps and other planned conversation operations are not disabled. Upstream retry behavior is unchanged outside the profile.

assertions: An actual compiled CLI, using its normal standalone server, sends native Abliteration chat requests to the broker with a local token.
The broker validates and reserializes payloads, substitutes the synthetic provider credential and contacts api.abliteration.ai:443 via SOCKS with the API role and session token.
The provider emits shell arguments in two SSE events. The actual shell writes a synthetic document, reads the attached context and returns it in the next native request.
Text arrives in multiple SSE events. A second CLI execution reopens the same session ID and sends previous context and response through the broker.
State files contain neither synthetic provider key nor local token, and no .log, .heapsnapshot or .cpuprofile files.
Revocation waits until the actual CLI emits step_start after provider output. The provider has sent no finish, DONE or EOF for that request.
Broker shutdown awaits HTTP task cancellation; the specific provider TLS connection closes, the response producer loses its receiver, the listener is gone and the CLI ends with an error.
During integrated CLI tests, the raw loopback sniffer observes only TCP IPv4, with zero UDP, IPv6, non-loopback endpoints, drops or truncation. Payloads are not persisted.

native_rust.reason: The compiled Linux CLI is exercised explicitly in the Debian VM, not silently counted as a native pass.

limits: Single VM component integration: direct Broker::revoke, not the LUKS controller/supervisor/two-VM active-stream path.
The generated test certificate and SOCKS endpoint replace remote infrastructure only inside the test; no live Tor/Abliteration compatibility claim.
Title-like requests are serviced if observed; dedicated titles, compaction and complete attachment cases remain open.
Application-state marker scans and packet counters are not a complete filesystem syscall audit or evidence of absent pre-transmission network attempts.
The base guest image retains the older CLI. Updated full images must include the new compiled profile; the successful run uses the verified read-only binary override.
Hardware KVM/x86, fault injection, full shutdown and independent security audit remain open.
